intro: Invited repeatedly across 2025 and 2026 to judge hackathons, AI competitions, and startup pitch events, evaluating the work of student builders and early-stage founders on innovation, technical depth, and real-world impact.

events.title: Mentor & Judge — HackMIT 2026 @ MIT
events.description: Invited as a mentor and judge at HackMIT 2026, held on campus at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, one of the largest and most competitive student hackathons globally with 1,000+ students from 200+ colleges. Mentored teams across technical domains and evaluated final projects on innovation, technical execution, and feasibility, recognized with a signed Certificate of Mentoring & Judging from the HackMIT Co-Director.

events.title: Judge — Frontier Cascadia @ UW Foster
events.description: Invited in-person judge at Frontier Cascadia, hosted at the University of Washington, Foster School of Business. Evaluated 50+ student teams (200+ students) across preliminary and final rounds, serving on a 12-judge panel alongside principal engineers, startup founders, and established industry leaders. Assessed product execution, technical feasibility, scalability, and business defensibility.

events.title: Judge — USAII Global AI Hackathon 2026
events.description: Core judge among approximately 80 judges for the United States Artificial Intelligence Institute (USAII) Global AI Hackathon, a fully virtual competition drawing student teams from 90+ countries. Scored up to 10 assigned teams on Devpost against a structured five-criterion rubric (problem understanding, AI reasoning, solution design, impact, and responsible AI). Featured by name in USAII's public Judges Appreciation spotlight, alongside senior industry peers.

events.title: Judge & Mentor — Decision Grade AI @ SF Tech Week
events.description: Judge and mentor at the Decision Grade AI buildathon during San Francisco Tech Week, evaluating team projects on technical depth and real-world impact before a 650+ attendee audience.

events.title: Judge — All You Can Do With AI (UT Dallas)
events.description: Hackathon judge for the University of Texas at Dallas "All You Can Do With AI" competition, scoring submissions on Devpost against the event rubric.

events.title: Judge — InfinityX Global Hackathon 2K26
events.description: Technical judge for the Machine Learning / AI and Web tracks, evaluating submissions from a global participant pool through asynchronous review.

events.title: Judge — TechCommons Hacks V2
events.description: Invited hackathon judge assessing projects on technical execution, innovation, and real-world impact.

events.title: Judge — AI Demo Day 4
events.description: Invited panel judge evaluating finalist presentations across AI, design, and technology, providing expert feedback to emerging teams.

events.title: Judge — Vibe Awards (Venture Miner)
events.description: Judge for the Vibe Awards, evaluating projects pitched live at Vibe Demo Days through asynchronous review across defined tracks.

events.title: Judge — Startup Pitch Panel (OJ Ventures)
events.description: Panel judge evaluating early-stage founder pitches, delivering live feedback and Q&A alongside a four-judge panel.

events.title: Judge — Vibe Pitch 8 (Venture Miner)
events.description: Live judge evaluating founder pitches during a Vibe Demo Day pitch session.
